changes: Preserve the complete supported Zelda II source ROM and native location edit recipe in native schema-13 projects.
Ordinary Build & Run uses a native backend: no-edit output matches every source byte; verified location field edits change only their declared packed bytes.
Source-independent packed records preserve flags/unknown bytes and validate masks, bounds and edit permissions; exercised in a fresh project without the source ROM.

Native location controls have one-step Undo/Redo, project save/open and an in-app/tutorial guide. Ordinary generated projects retain schema 12, their exact recipe identities and byte-identical example ROMs.

automatedResult.note: All mandatory suites freshly measured on unchanged frozen app inputs after reserving schema 13 for native projects and preserving ordinary schema-12 identities. Resumable supervision uses up to four bounded workers; each invocation and unchanged-deadline retry is recorded; this does not claim an uninterrupted standard-runner execution.

preservedParent.method: Exact reversal reconstructs the parent application and all protected test inventories. CPU/APU/PPU, generated engine emitters and world geometry codec remain unchanged. World ROM source-schema and mashup validation accept ordinary schema-13 projects; native backend dispatch, native project lifecycle, UI and allowed location-span recognition are explicit changes.

exampleEvidence.note: All 14 saved examples rebuild byte-identical whole ROMs. Original projects, recipes, source evidence and ROM artifacts remain unchanged; six HTML identity receipts are refreshed.

limits: One verified Zelda II engine adapter; unknown games/revisions remain inspectable without invented native support.

Only native location X/Y, scene-selector and packed entry-code edits have encoders. Special unresolved scene contexts and unavailable destinations are refused. Coordinates/entry edits can still produce unreachable or unsafe locations; terrain/icons are separate data.

One reference room World is adapted; this is not the assembled overworld, complete scene graph or full game translation. Generic art, World, tracker or runtime changes are saved but block native builds until encoders exist.
Original native logic remains source-bound. Generic movement-mode components, complete route conditions/return state, collision, AI, combat, progression and remaining native encoders are unfinished.
No private ROM or generated native project is distributed. Checks use the shared CPU core on an independent bounded bus and headless Chromium; no hardware, physical Windows or listening acceptance.
promotion: Development checkpoint toward the next alpha. Existing alpha.11 release number retained; no alpha promotion, beta claim, new kit or main merge.
